defs.def: feeling or showing a lot of excitement and interest about sb/sth 热情的；热心的；热烈的；满腔热忱的adv.

ex.t: 一条充满热情的正面评论。

ex.s: Though wastED received enthusiastic reviews, it was designed from the start as a short-lived experiment; Blue Hill has since returned to its regular menu.
ex.t: 尽管wastED收获了热烈好评，它从一开始就被设计成短期实验；Blue Hill此后已恢复常规菜单。

ex.s: Fortunately for those in midlife, Levine is finding that even if you haven't been an enthusiastic exerciser, getting in shape now may help improve your aging heart.
ex.t: 对那些中年人来说幸运的是，莱文发现，即使你一直不是热衷锻炼的人，现在开始健身也可能有助于改善你衰老的心脏。

ex.s: I was always an enthusiastic reader, sometimes reading up to three books a day as a child.
ex.t: 我一直以来都是个热忱的读者，小时候有时一天能读三本书。

ex.s: Last Friday， after he arrived at the school， instead of finding garbage to clean up， he found almost 800 students lining the hallways with handmade cards， blowing noisemakers and singing a full﹣throated happy birthday to him． It was his 80th． As he walked the long hallway， some popped out of line to hug him． They handed him so many cards that they filled several large boxes． Touched by their enthusiastic expression of affection， Mabry thanked them all． "They're like my children，" Mabry said．
ex.t: 上周五，他到学校后，没找到要清理的垃圾，却发现有近800名学生排在教学楼走廊里，举着手制卡片，吹着闹响器，扯着嗓子给他唱生日快乐歌。那天是他80岁生日。当他走过长长的走廊时，有些人跳出队伍拥抱他。他们递给他的卡片多得装满了好几个大箱子。被他们热情流露的关爱所打动，马布里向所有人道谢。“他们就像我的孩子，”马布里说。

ex.s: Moore is enthusiastic about the candy she created, and she's also positive about what the future might bring.
ex.t: 然后摩尔用她的积蓄创办了自己的企业。

ex.s: But I was so enthusiastic about the idea of going along with them that I secretly went aboard his ship, the Endurance, and hid in a small cupboard.
ex.t: 但是我非常想和他们一起去，所以偷偷登上了他的船“耐力号”，躲在一个小橱柜里。

ex.s: They are friendly, sociable, talkative, enthusiastic and self-confident.
ex.t: 他们友好、好交际、健谈、热情且自信。

ex.s: However, because Helen was so enthusiastic about learning, the results were amazing.
ex.t: 然而，由于海伦对学习如此热情，取得的成果令人惊叹。

ex.s: The crowd immediately recognized that they were listening to something truly special, and they broke into enthusiastic cheers at the end of the symphony.
ex.t: 观众立刻意识到他们正在聆听一些真正特别的音乐，在交响乐结束时爆发出热烈的欢呼声。

ex.s: FRANK: The entertainment industry is one of the most enthusiastic advocates of VR.
ex.t: 弗兰克：娱乐业是虚拟现实最热情的倡导者之一。
